models.title: Simple conversation · about you, food, travel, family (A2)

block.label: SPEAKING · SIMPLE CONVERSATION
block.html: Answer with complete sentences. Then add one more detail: because…, and…, but…

cats.name: About you
qs: Where do you live? Do you like it there?
What do you do? Do you like your job?
What do you usually do on Saturdays?
What time do you usually wake up?
What is your favorite day of the week? Why?
What makes you happy?
What is your favorite season? Why?
Describe your best friend.

cats.name: Your week
qs: How was your week?
What did you do last weekend?
What did you eat yesterday?
Who did you talk to today?
What was the best part of your day?
What are you going to do tonight?
Did you watch anything good this week?
What do you need to do tomorrow?

cats.name: Food
qs: What is your favorite food?
What did you have for breakfast today?
Do you like to cook? What can you cook?
What is a typical food from your city?
Do you prefer sweet or salty food?
What food do you hate?
What is the best restaurant you know?
What do you usually drink with lunch?

cats.name: Places & travel
qs: What is the most beautiful place in your city?
Where did you go on your last trip?
Do you prefer the beach or the mountains? Why?
Which city do you want to visit? Why?
How do you go to work: by car, by bus, on foot?
What is the best place you have visited?
Do you like to travel alone or with friends?
What do you always take on a trip?

cats.name: Experiences (I have…)
qs: Say a city you have visited many times.
Say a food you have eaten and loved.
Say an animal you have seen on a farm.
Say a famous person you have seen on TV many times.
Say something you have lost.
Say a sport you have played.
Say a movie you have watched twice.
Say something you have made with your hands.

cats.name: Family & home
qs: How many people are there in your family?
Who do you live with?
Describe your house or apartment.
What is your favorite room at home? Why?
Do you have pets? Tell me about them.
Who is the funniest person in your family?
What do you usually do with your family on Sundays?
What did you do on your last birthday?

cats.name: Free time
qs: What do you do to relax?
Do you like music? What kind?
Do you play any sports?
What is your favorite movie or series?
Do you prefer staying at home or going out?
What did you do when you were a child for fun?
What new hobby do you want to try?
What is something you can do very well?
